evidence.title: Lanes docs: Deep Links

evidence.title: Lanes docs: Voice Dictation

evidence.title: Lanes docs: Harness

evidence.title: Lanes docs: Git Identity

evidence.title: Lanes Desktop product page
evidence.finding: macOS app; drives official CLIs in a local PTY with the user's shell, dotfiles and login; requests never proxy through Lanes servers so users pay providers directly; loops have hard stops on tries, budget and wall clock (mechanism not described); code, prompts and terminal history are not stored on Lanes servers.

evidence.title: Lanes Security & Trust
evidence.finding: Local-first: prompts and terminal output stay local; Desktop MCP runs locally. Remote workspace data in Supabase EU with row-level security; members see only issues and sessions they can access; synced data is issue metadata, membership, issue comments and session pointers. SSO via Google implemented; SAML and enterprise SSO and admin audit logs Planned. Sub-processors: Firebase Authentication, Supabase, Resend, Stripe, Google Analytics 4 (consent-gated) and Sentry. Retention account-bound, deletion within 30 days.

evidence.title: Lanes pricing
evidence.finding: Free $0 (1 user), Pro $19/month (up to 10 members), Enterprise custom via sales. Every plan includes unlimited local sessions, multi-agent orchestration and MCP/CLI access. Invites and Admin/Editor roles start at Pro; SSO and SAML, audit log and data residency are Enterprise. Remote workspaces, Slack and Automations are marked Coming soon; Lanes Compute GPUs are Coming soon and billed separately.

evidence.title: Lanes Privacy Policy
evidence.locator: Analytics and Telemetry Data; 10 Data Retention; 12 Cookies; Google user data

evidence.title: Lanes Terms and Conditions
evidence.finding: Lanes provides no AI models or agents; users bring their own provider accounts. Remote workspaces store issue and session data via Supabase in Europe. Fees paid are non-refundable.
